title: csharp-minifier deployment diagram
description: How csharp-minifier runs on a developer's machine: one self-contained executable started from a terminal, by a coding agent, or by the git pre-commit hook it installs in the repositories it changes. Nothing runs anywhere else.

nodes.name: Developer's machine
nodes.description: macOS (arm64 or x64), or Linux; everything below runs here as the same user.

nodes.name: Developer's terminal
nodes.description: Runs the tool's commands by hand.

nodes.name: Coding agent
nodes.description: Runs the tool as the installed skill tells it to, after changing C#.

nodes.name: csharp-minifier
nodes.description: One short-lived process per run: plans every change in memory, verifies it, then writes, or with --check only reports.

nodes.name: git pre-commit hook
nodes.description: The block the tool writes into the repository's pre-commit file; runs the tool with --check on the staged .cs files.
nodes.condition: In repositories the tool has changed

nodes.name: git
nodes.description: Child process for finding the work tree and reading and setting core.hooksPath; must be on PATH.

nodes.name: The C# repository
nodes.description: The source tree the tool rewrites, with its AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, skill file and hook.

nodes.name: Claude CLI (claude -p)
nodes.description: One fresh, unsaved session per benchmark run, on the user's Claude account, in the benchmark- clone.

nodes.name: benchmark-<name> clone
nodes.description: A copy-on-write copy of the root in the same parent folder, transformed by the given switches; replaced by the next benchmark.

nodes.name: ~/.zazzle/agent-token-benchmarks
nodes.description: Per repository, commit, prompt and run: meta.json, prompt.txt, transform.txt, run-1..3.jsonl and .json, and summary.json with tokens per run and per turn and the tools each turn called.

artifacts.name: csharp-minifier (single-file executable)
artifacts.description: dotnet publish src -c Release -r <rid>: self-contained, single file, ReadyToRun, not signed; put on PATH by hand. Not part of the v* release.

relationships.description: Started from the terminal, by an agent or by the hook.
Command line, as the skill says.
xargs passes the staged .cs paths with --check and the recorded switches; a non-zero exit refuses the commit.
Reads and rewrites source files; writes the skill, AGENTS.md section and hook block.
Spawned with an argument list and a timeout, never through a shell.
Started by the tool, three times per prompt.
Prompt on standard input; a stream-json transcript of every turn and tool call on standard output.
Reads the clone; dontAsk denies edits and commands.
Writes the results of every run.
